$\text{Slope}=\dfrac{\text{Rise}}{\text{Run}}=\dfrac{\text{Change in }y}{\text{Change in }x}$

We can calculate the change in $x$ and change in $y$ by picking any two pairs of corresponding $x$- and $y$-values.

$\begin{array}{lrrrr}
&&\xrightarrow{+5}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow{+5}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow{+5}\,\,\,\,
\\
x
&31
&36
&41
&46
\\
\hline
\\
y
&10
&8
&6
&4
\\
&&\xrightarrow[-2]{}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow[-2]{}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow[-2]{}\,\,\,\,
\end{array}$

So the slope is:

$\dfrac{\text{Change in }y}{\text{Change in }x}=\dfrac{-2}{5}=-\dfrac25$
